entities.summary: Eritrea is a sovereign nation in East Africa, Africa. Its capital is Asmara. Official languages include Tigrinya, Arabic, English. Government: Unitary one-party presidential republic (de facto single-party state). Population: approximately 3.7 million. Area: 117,600 km². Comprehensive index for Eritrea covering Aksumite heritage, Italian Eritrea, British administration, Ethiopian federation and annexation, 30-year liberation war, independence 1993, Isaias Afwerki's isolation, and Tigray War involvement.
